At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. 

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world. 

The Raytheon team is looking for a Software Engineering Intern to support the Missile Defense Sensors (MDS) Software (SW) Department in the summer of 2027.  The MDS SW mission is to provide world class Radar and Command and Control (C2) Software for our customers’ wide array of Surveillance and Warning Systems. We align to the core Agile and DevSecOps principles of collaborative operation across the entire value stream, delivering high-frequency, high-quality deployments to our customers.  We strive for technical excellence by drawing upon a workforce whose knowledge base covers the complete spectrum of modern computing languages and platforms. 

As a member of our team, you will design, develop, test, and release software products for one of our Radar or C2 programs. Some of the programs our department supports include the AN/TPY-2 Radar ( https://www.rtx.com/raytheon/what-we-do/strategic-missile-defense/antpy-2), the Sea-Based X-Band Radar (SBX/XBR), and the Taiwan Surveillance Radar Program (SRP). 

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in software design and development, an eagerness to learn, the ability to work 100% onsite and collaboratively with a team, and an interest in complex, real-time, safety-critical systems. 

What You Will Do as a Software Engineer: 

Work on an agile team responsible for developing and delivering software for one of the MDS Department’s programs.  

Specific responsibilities include: 

Assist and participate in the requirements, design, development and testing of real-time application software and tools, to include development of new work products or enhancement of existing applications and systems. 

Participate in internal reviews of software components and systems. 

Work on problems with defined scope, schedule, and expectations. 

Follow established development practices and processes to maintain the configuration management of software products. 

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance prior to the start date. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance. 

What You Will Learn:

The workings of Missile Defense Systems and/or Command and Control (C2) Systems. 

How to develop and maintain large-scale, complex software solutions in an agile environment. 

Testing frameworks and best practices to enable high-quality software deliveries utilizing Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery concepts. 

Qualifications You Must Have: 

Must be pursuing a Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in an applicable discipline and actively ++enrolled through completion of the internship / co-op session.

Must have a minimum of 60 hours of credit by the start of the internship / co-op session. 

Experience developing software with C, C++,  Java, or Ada. 

Qualifications We Prefer:

Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins), configuration management tools (Git, Bitbucket, Artifactory), and data analysis tools (MATLAB, Python). 

Knowledge of data structures and algorithms, memory management, and multithreaded applications. 

Well-developed communication, technical writing, oral presentation, and interpersonal skills. 

Experience contributing to a team environment for the purpose of developing creative solutions to complex technical problems. 

Ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment with time-critical requirements. 

Ability to promote a culture of continuous learning, cross-team collaboration and training. 

What We Offer:

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

Software Engineer Internship – Technology Business Development & Client Solutions

Intern

Department: Internships

Work Environment: Hybrid

Pay Grade: 1

Company Description

Why choose an internship with Wellmark? We strive to offer meaningful work that assists in your professional development and provides value to the team. You will gain valuable experience within the health insurance industry and put the skills and knowledge you’ve acquired in school to practice this summer during our 2027 Summer Internship Program. You will have the opportunity to learn from subject matter experts and leaders within the industry, network with fellow internship program participants, and gain practical, hands-on work experience.

If you’re eager to learn, collaborate with others, demonstrate your potential, develop customer-focused solutions, and grow into an exciting career, we hope you’ll consider an internship with us!

Job Description

What’s Application Development in our Technology Division? At a time when technology is creating new business models, disrupting industries and creating valuable experiences for consumers, our role as technology team members must elevate an organization through innovative transformation, modernized technology and delivery of new business strategies, including an aim to continuously evolve and enhance the customer experience. This position is responsible for supporting many of Wellmark's member, employer, and provider-facing digital applications.

What projects might I support? Although subject to change, examples of projects you will be contributing to include:

Collaborate with Technology and business stakeholders to troubleshoot and resolve production support issues

Active participation in team ceremonies for work breakdown, estimation, sequencing, and continuous improvement

Full stack development opportunities for new features

Contribute to creating inclusive, accessible, and user-friendly websites by applying WCAG best practices

Develop business knowledge of the application necessary to effectively provide support maintenance

Ready to bring your strengths to Wellmark? Here’s what’s next! Review the qualifications below. If the position is a match with your passion and interests, submit your application today!

This internship will start in May of 2027, working a hybrid schedule from our headquarters in Des Moines.

Qualifications

Current junior or senior student pursing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, or related field

Knowledge of software development technologies (NodeJS, Angular, .NET, MongoDB, SQL)

Strong analytical problem-solving skills. Accuracy and high attention to detail and self-starter.

Ability to troubleshoot and develop creative technical solutions.

Demonstrated computer skills with Microsoft Office products (Word, Access, PowerPoint and Excel)

Excellent writing and communication skills

Preferred:

Prior work experience in an office environment or internship

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

The policy of Wellmark Blue Cross Blue Shield is to recruit, hire, train and promote individuals in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation due to a disability at any stage of the employment application process should contact us at [email protected]

Please inform us if you meet the definition of a "Covered DoD official".

At this time, Wellmark is not considering applicants for this position that require any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States. This includes, but IS NOT LIMITED TO: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, etc. For additional information around work authorization needs please refer to the following resources:Nonimmigrant Workers and Green Card for Employment-Based Immigrants

Summer 2027 Internship - Software Engineering

Los Angeles, CA

Apply

About the company 

General Matter enriches uranium.

We are designing, building, and operating the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services, here in the US.  

In the process, we are restoring America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel to power AI, advanced manufacturing and critical industries our country relies on to remain competitive. 

Fuel drives the cost of advanced reactor electricity production, and enrichment drives the cost of the fuel that advanced reactors consume.  Reliable, low-cost enrichment is the catalyst for the nuclear Renaissance now under way.

Our mission is to make nuclear not only the cleanest and safest source of baseload power, but also the most affordable.  We believe abundant nuclear energy will lead to a post-scarcity society. 

We were incubated inside Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by over a dozen of the world's top venture capital firms.  

Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production.  

We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency. 

Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable. 

About This Role

As a General Matter Software Engineering Intern, you will help develop performant, safe, and high-quality software. Your work will support code where reliability, performance, and safety are of utmost importance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including electrical engineers, software engineers, chemical engineers, manufacturing engineers, nuclear engineers, materials scientists, and physicists. If you seek high-impact work and are excited by fast-paced, intense, Skunkworks-style projects, we encourage you to reach out to join our team.

We're hiring interns across three focus areas:

Backend interns will help build high-performance services and APIs that coordinate control systems, manage state across distributed hardware, and expose interfaces for monitoring and operations.

Distributed systems interns will support the development of fault-tolerant coordination systems, real-time data pipelines processing high-throughput sensor telemetry, and the infrastructure that keeps critical systems running reliably at scale.

Tooling interns will help build the developer platforms, CI/CD systems, observability tools, and deployment infrastructure that let our team iterate rapidly and safely in a production environment where mistakes have physical consequences.

Responsibilities

Assist in designing and implementing high-performance software systems in C++ and Python, with a focus on reliability and maintainability.

Support the architecture of solutions, contributing to decisions around system design, performance trade-offs, and technology selection.

Participate in technical design reviews and code reviews, learning and helping uphold engineering best practices across the team.

Help build and maintain automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to support software quality at scale.

Work closely with senior engineers, contributing to progress on complex, ambiguous technical problems.

Basic Qualifications

Current undergraduate or graduate student pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Proficiency in C++ and/or Python.

Strong CS fundamentals, such as algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and system design.

Collaborative team member who thrives in fast-paced, multidisciplinary environments and is eager to learn.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Exposure to distributed systems, observability tooling, or infrastructure as code.

Experience with Python ecosystems for data pipelines, automation, or backend services.

Coursework or project experience with C++ performance optimization, profiling, or low-level systems programming.

Familiarity with Linux system programming, including threading models, IPC, or low-level kernel interfaces.

Evidence of exceptional ability (prior projects, portfolio of work, completed products, etc).

Additional Requirements

Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary.

Equal Opportunity Employer

General Matter is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with General Matter is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Compensation and Benefits

The hourly pay range for this internship is $32–$46 per hour, depending on the candidate's current standing in school (i.e. sophomore, senior).

Interns will receive a monthly housing stipend and are eligible for overtime pay. Please note that the stated hourly range is an estimate and may be adjusted based on market conditions, business needs, or other factors.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

This is a 12-week internship during summer 2027. 

You'll join Coinbase as a software engineer intern and help build the next generation of crypto-forward products and features. You'll solve large-scale, complex technical problems at the intersection of web-scale applications and blockchain technology, shipping real code that impacts millions of users.

During the application process, you'll select your preferred team from the groups below. Your application will be primarily considered for your selected team in the specified location. Following the hybrid internship, any full-time return opportunity would be remote-first.

Product Group Teams (internship location = San Francisco):  

Base - Scale the crypto economy by creating integrations, fiat onramps, and developer tools on Coinbase's Ethereum L2 network, connecting builders to 108M+ users and $100B+ in assets.

Consumer - Build the fastest way to access crypto through the Coinbase retail and wallet apps, advanced trade, dApps, and staking.

Developer - Help build out Coinbase Developer Platform - trusted crypto infrastructure at scale. Payments, Wallets, Trading, and Stablecoin APIs for the global financial system.

Institutional - Enable thousands of large financial institutions to securely custody digital assets, stake, and participate in the crypto economy.

Platform - Create the scalable, compliant foundational systems (Identity, FinHub, Payments, Blockchain and Infrastructure) that underpin all Coinbase products.

Core Teams (internship location = New York City):  

Security - Build solutions for critical security, compliance, and privacy needs, including the Workforce IAM Platform and security oversight tooling.

Enterprise AI - Build AI-powered tools and platforms that boost employee productivity and collaboration, partnering with ML, IT, and HR to bring custom and third-party AI solutions into everyday workflows.

Enterprise Engineering (EE) - Develop platforms that enhance customer support, internal tools and compliance through automation and customer-first engineering.

What you'll do:

Write high-quality, well-tested code that ships to production and directly impacts Coinbase customers.

Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers to turn technical and product vision into delivered features.

Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving feedback that raises the quality bar for your team.

Own a defined project end-to-end, from scoping through implementation and launch, within your 12-week internship.

Learn and apply crypto and blockchain domain concepts to real engineering problems in a production environment.

Required Skills and Experience:

Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots (e.g., LibreChat, Gemini, Glean) in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human‑in‑the‑loop practices to deliver business‑ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality.

Programming experience in any language (academic, personal projects, or professional).

Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous problems into concrete implementation steps.

Familiarity with at least one of: web development, mobile development, backend systems, or infrastructure.

Utilize generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

$60 - $60 USD

Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Software Engineer - Intern (Summer 2027)

Redwood City, California, United States · Internships · Employment Type: Intern

C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: C3 AI

C3 AI is searching for brilliant and ambitious Software Engineer Interns to join our Summer 2027 cohort. This isn't your average internship; you'll be on the front lines, designing and developing mission-critical AI applications that help solve some of the world's most complex problems.

As an intern, you’ll be embedded directly into our Platform or Forward Deployed Engineering teams, shipping code that matters from day one. You won't just be learning—you'll be contributing, collaborating with world-class engineers, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with our revolutionary C3 AI Suite.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain performant and scalable applications.

Build and improve tools for internal C3 teams to understand and analyze large-scale data.

Work closely with and incorporate feedback from Products and Engineering teams.

Define and lead end-to-end development of applications.

Qualifications:

Pursuing a Bachelor of Science or Master of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.

Experience with JavaScript, Java, or other object-oriented programming language.

Strong hands-on experience and understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, profiling & optimization.

Real passion for developing team-oriented solutions to complex engineering problems.

Thrive in an autonomous, empowering and exciting environment.

Great verbal and written communication skills to collaborate multi-functionally and improve scalability.

Interest in committing to a fun, friendly, expansive, and intellectually stimulating environment.

C3 AI provides excellent benefits and a competitive compensation package, which include:  

Salary range: $8,000 - $10,000 USD per month.

At the office, we offer a fully stocked kitchen with catered lunches, a free on-site gym membership, biweekly social hour with food, drinks, music, and plenty of opportunities to connect and network with your team.

C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status.

Software Engineer, Platform

As a Software Engineer, on the core platform team at C3 AI, you will be involved in the full software development lifecycle, from design to maintenance. This role focuses on building foundational components, frameworks, and tools for distributed applications. We're seeking individuals with strong computer science fundamentals and proficiency in Java or similar programming languages. The ideal candidate is a problem-solver with a passion for tackling complex challenges.

Forward Deployed Engineer

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at C3 AI, you will be building and deploying full-stack, AI-driven web applications for our clients. This customer facing role, requires hands-on software development expertise in languages such as Python and JavaScript, along with strong analytical and communication skills to effectively work with C3 AI customers. As a key member on the team, not only will you develop applications, you will also mentor peers, troubleshoot issues, and deliver technical training on the C3 AI platform. Experience with cloud platforms, machine learning, and databases is a plus.

About us

Quadrillion is a startup building Qualia, an agentic research platform (think Jupyter or VS Code, but with AI agents that do the actual research). Our users are ML researchers, quants, and data scientists who use Qualia to run an entire research project from a single prompt. 

We're a 12-person team in NYC, backed by $18.3M from Conviction, Audacious, Bloomberg Beta, ex/ante, and Wes McKinney (creator of pandas). We have one of the strongest NYC AI teams, with backgrounds from HRT, Google Research, Citadel, and Jane Street.

The role

Your role will be the same as any Quadrillion full-time engineer's: shipping real product changes, fixing customer bugs, and building new features. 

We're hiring interns for a couple of our groups:

Agent Engineering builds the core infrastructure that our agents run on: orchestrating agent loops, building the sandboxed environments where agents run experiments against real data, designing the APIs and tooling researchers touch, and scaling the infrastructure that keeps it fast and reliable.

Product builds an incredibly strong UI for agents to run in and for humans to interact with, both as a Mac/Windows app and on the cloud.

What you'll do

Build effective systems for agent orchestration. You'll engineer the core system that drives Qualia, improving its ability to reason over long horizons, run parallel experiments, and manage its knowledge.

Scale environments for agent experiments and training. Help us build the sandboxed compute where agents run complex, high-performance experiments, and scale it to tens of thousands of concurrent deployments.

Expand what agents can do and where they run. Build and deploy the tools and integrations that connect Qualia to customers' data sources and external systems.

Required qualifications

Strong full-stack or backend engineering experience, especially with Python

Comfort working in unfamiliar codebases

Ability to move quickly in a zero-to-one environment

Who we're hiring

We're hiring a strong intern with significant engineering chops in either Python or React. We prefer sophomores and juniors but are open to frosh. You must be a current undergraduate at a US or Canadian university.

About this role

We work in-person 5 days a week out of our office in Midtown Manhattan. We cover generous benefits for employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, lunch and dinner covered, and other varied stipends.

We pride ourselves on a company culture that values a diversity of thoughts and opinions.

About Quadrillion

Quadrillion Labs builds Qualia, an agentic research intelligence platform that does real computational research — running experiments, analyzing data, and surfacing insight for the people who do this work at the highest level.

We're a team out of Stanford NLP, HRT, Citadel, Jane Street, Google Research, and Harvard Med, building for an audience that looks a lot like us. We've raised ~$18M from Conviction, Audacious, Bloomberg Beta, ex/ante, and angels including Wes McKinney, the creator of pandas. We're ~10 people in NYC, scaling to ~15 in the coming months.

We think this is the Industrial Revolution moment for research, and we're building the team to define what comes next.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Quadrillion Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring and employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We are committed to building a team where talented people can do their best work.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, let us know at careers@quadrillion.io.

We

2027 Summer Intern - Technology Analyst, Software Engineering  

  

Internship positions are located at PIMCO’s office in Austin, Texas.  

 

About the role:  

Our PIMCO Technology teams produce technology solutions to help our firm make investment decisions, manage portfolio risk, and serve our clients.  

 

As a Technology Analyst at PIMCO, you will sit at the intersection of finance and technology, solve fast-paced problems, and drive innovation. Over 10 weeks during the summer, interns work alongside engineers, developers, investment professionals, and analytics teams to develop cutting-edge software and deliver value-add tools.  

 

You'll have the chance to define your career with a dynamic, growing global investment management leader while working with a smart, fun team. 

  

You are eligible to apply if you:   

Are a currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering or a similar major 

Must be able to begin full-time employment at the Austin PIMCO office between January 2028 – August 2028 

Must be enrolled at a university during the Fall 2027 semester (August 2027 – December 2027) 

Have a minimum 3.5 cumulative collegiate grade point average, on a 4.0 scale or the equivalent, at an accredited four-year college or university 

Are fluent in English (speaking, reading, writing) 

  

You’ll excel as a Technology Analyst if you:  

Are curious with strong problem-solving skills and the desire to take ownership and drive solutions to completion 

Possess strong programming skills, such as Python, Java, C#, C++, SQL, RDBMS, and data warehouse skills or experience 

Possess superb interpersonal skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to stakeholders across the firm 

Have the ability to work well independently and in a team environment 

Have demonstrated curiosity and experience in using new emerging technologies and AI tools in your work or school projects to solve problems and drive better outcomes   

  

  

The PIMCO internship experience:   

The PIMCO Internship is a 10-week program that runs from early June to mid-August, with the expectation that you will be available for the full duration of the program 

During Week 1, you’ll participate in PIMCO Fundamentals Training, providing you with the skills, knowledge, and relationships that will prepare you for success. 

During Week 2, you will dive into PIMCO’s technology ecosystem and enhance your developer skills through PIMCO Technology University (PTU) Intern Bootcamp.  

Your supervisor, mentor, past-intern peers, senior leaders, and team offer guidance and mentorship throughout the summer. 

You will gain hands-on experience with AI-powered tools from day one, with training and resources that help build future ready skills and make an impact from the start. 

Alongside your colleagues, you’ll have opportunities to give back to the community through PIMCO's Global Month of Volunteering, developed to heighten the impact of our employees' worldwide volunteer efforts. 

You’ll be invited to join a variety of cross-divisional education, networking & social events! 

You’ll receive feedback through the formal review process at mid- and end-of-summer to keep you on the path to meeting your goals. 

As a PIMCO intern, you’ll receive competitive compensation, along with a transition bonus to help with relocation to our Austin, Texas office location. 

  

  

Want to learn more? Hear about The PIMCO Internship Experience from past interns  

 

  

What to expect during the interview process:   

After we receive your application, we will conduct an initial review of your resume   

Selected candidates are asked to complete a HackerRank assessment to demonstrate technical skill level.  

If you are selected to move forward, you will take a cognitive assessment and have the opportunity to showcase your interests, skills, and personality by completing a one-way video interview   

Once you complete the assessment and one-way video interview, you will have a final round of live interviews via video conference. These interviews typically include both behavioral and technical questions 

 

 

PIMCO is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive, cognitively diverse environment.  

  

For more information on PIMCO and Career Opportunities, please visit www.pimco.com/careers  

  

 

PIMCO follows a total compensation approach when rewarding employees which includes a base salary and a discretionary bonus. Base salary is the fixed component of compensation that is determined by core job responsibilities, relevant experience, internal level, and market factors. The discretionary bonus is used to award performance and therefore is determined by company, business, team, and individual performance.

Responsibilities

The Trust and Safety (TnS) engineering team is responsible for protecting our users from harmful content and abusive behaviors. With the continuous efforts of our trust and safety engineering team, TikTok can provide the best user experience and bring joy to everyone in the world. Our team is responsible for achieving goals by building content moderation process systems, rule engines, strategy systems, feature engines, human moderation platforms, risk insight systems, and all kinds of supportive platforms across TnS organization.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.
Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

* This opening is part of the general hiring process for the Data-TnS-Engineering organization. Applications will be evaluated by multiple teams within the Data-TnS-Engineering organization to ensure the best alignment based on skills and interests.

Online Assessment
Candidates who pass resume screening will be invited to participate in TikTok's technical online assessment.

Responsibilities: 
- Collaborate with Trust and Safety experts, machine learning engineers, and other cross-functional teams on delivering key results.
- Design technical solutions with team members.
- Implement technical solutions to support business requirements.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: 
- Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master degree in Software Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Able to commit to working for 12 weeks during the Summer of 2027. 
- Prior experience working with languages like Go/Python/PHP/C++/C/Java.
- Strong experience with Data Structures and Algorithms.
- Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Qualifications: 
- Demonstrated software engineering experience from previous internships, work experience, projects, or coding competitions.
- High levels of creativity and quick problem-solving capabilities.

As a condition of employment, all successful candidates must be able to establish authorization to work in the United States. For this position, the Company does not provide sponsorship or any immigration-related benefits.

By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy

Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Interns have day one access to health insurance, life insurance, wellbeing benefits and more. Interns also receive 10 paid holidays per year and paid sick time (56 hours if hired in first half of year, 40 if hired in second half of year). TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

Software Engineer Intern — Summer 2027

San Francisco

Apply

Apply early for priority consideration. Gallup has limited openings for this internship, and the position will be filled quickly.

As a software engineer intern at Gallup, you’ll help shape the technology behind the digital experiences that bring our research, analytics and strengths-based solutions to people around the world. You’ll contribute to active engineering work, collaborate with experienced developers and tackle problems that ask you to think beyond the obvious answer.

We’re looking for engineers who are curious about what’s possible, learn new technologies quickly, enjoy solving complex problems and want to experiment with how AI can improve products and experiences. You’ll have the opportunity to write code, test ideas and learn what it takes to turn promising concepts into useful technology.

What You’ll Do 

During your internship, you will:

Build and enhance customer-facing applications across the front end and back end using technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, databases and SQL

Contribute to products and experiences that help Gallup acquire new customers, engage existing customers and connect people with Gallup’s solutions

Explore how AI and emerging technologies can create smarter, more personalized experiences based on users’ needs and interactions

Turn promising ideas into proofs of concept, experimenting quickly to determine what works and where new technology can create value

Tackle engineering challenges by evaluating options, developing practical solutions and improving your work through testing and iteration

Collaborate with engineers and other partners to design, build, test and improve high-quality software

What You Need 

Enrollment in an associate, bachelor’s or graduate degree program in computer science, MIS or a related field required

Classroom, project, internship or work experience coding in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, SQL or another development language required

Aptitude in programming analysis, design and creative problem-solving required

Curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, with an interest in experimenting with new tools and applying them to engineering challenges preferred

Enrollment at a college or university within an 80-mile radius of San Francisco, California, required

Anticipated graduation between August 2027 and May 2028 preferred; will consider 2029 graduates

Availability to work 40 hours per week for 12 weeks during the summer of 2027 required

A commitment to working on-site at Gallup’s San Francisco office Monday through Thursday required, with the option to work remotely on Friday

Eligibility to work in the United States required; this position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship

What We Offer

A full-time summer 2027 internship that pays $45 to $50 per hour

The potential to work up to 20 hours per week during the school year, depending on business demands

The potential for a full-time job offer upon graduation, based on Gallup’s business needs and intern performance

What You’ll Experience

Mission-driven work: Make a meaningful difference in the world through work that applies science and technology to important human and organizational problems.

An empowering culture: Collaborate with smart, passionate people who welcome your ideas, perspectives and technical judgment.

Learning and development: Grow your skills through hands-on research, experimentation and exposure to AI systems, extensive data and engineering challenges.

Room to challenge assumptions: Work in an environment where curiosity, rigorous thinking and questioning existing approaches are expected.

Brand strength, startup energy: Work on emerging technology in a fast-moving environment backed by Gallup’s research, science and global brand.

A vibrant workplace: Work from Gallup’s San Francisco office in the heart of the Financial District, steps from the Embarcadero and public transit.

Our teams produce great work together, inspire each other to deliver exceptional outcomes, grow their potential and celebrate each other along the way. Learn more about our work and life at Gallup.

Gallup is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

To review Gallup’s Privacy Statement, please click this link: https://www.gallup.com/privacy. This privacy policy is meant to help you understand what information we collect, why we collect it, and how you can update, manage and delete your information. Your application and the information you provide will be processed and stored in the United States.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

As an intern at Affirm, you will be a contributing member of our outstanding engineering team, and as such you will work on meaningful projects and frequently ship code. Recent grads and past interns have built a real-time high-throughput data processing pipeline, developed an extensive automated testing framework, and built out our proprietary financial platform that is central to our long term company mission.

We are excited to meet and consider strong students for our 12-16 week internships. We are a dynamic organization that is happy to tailor projects to your skills, and we will work with you throughout the interview process to determine which team will be best for you.

What You'll Do
Interns are responsible for developing and shipping a project and verifying that it works in production. Because things are changing fast at Affirm, we do not specify intern projects in advance, instead you will collaborate with your mentor and manager when you start to spec a project that will best contribute to your team.

This role will ship code and monitor the deployment of your work. Our intern projects are not isolated or intended to be thrown away: your team will depend on your contributions!
We pair interns with a dedicated mentor who will be by your side to give advice and ensure the success of your project. Expect to meet with them on a regular basis and receive feedback.
There are opportunities to attend events with other interns and full-time Affirmers! Past events have included virtual cooking classes, executive fireside chats, cable car trolley tours, and Giants games.
Interns present their work to the entire engineering organization at the end of the internship.

Melius — New York City

Engineers have Cursor. Lawyers have Harvey. The office of the CFO has Ramp. Every knowledge profession has been handed a platform that lets them orchestrate agents and scale their output by an order of magnitude — except the people who actually make the things we look at, watch, and listen to.

Melius is the agents lab for creative work. We build agentic interfaces to all the work that goes into building the next generation of images, video, audio and so much more. Generative media canvas, timeline editor, asset manager, and much more, built native for agents. Using Melius, users can spend more time being creative and let go of the century old legacy tools that only acted as constraints to their imagination.

We’re backed by General Catalyst, Vine Ventures, Genius Ventures, and Antifund, and built by a team of second-time founders, former engineering leaders from Ramp, and operators who came up through top-tier VC and PE. We move fast, ship every day, and have strong opinions about craft.

The role

This is not a “summer project” internship. Expect to be treated exactly as a full time engineer would be from the first day at your job. There will be dozens of projects that you lead and are expected to educate both customers and other members of the team on.

The stack: Next.js and a real-time CRDT canvas on the frontend, NestJS / MikroORM / Postgres / Temporal / Turbopuffer on the backend, and the agent and model orchestration layer that ties it all together.

High level activities for the internship might include:

Building new tools for our agent end-to-end — what it can do on the canvas, what it can change in the timeline editor, and how it can semantically search in the asset manager.

Sitting in on user sessions, watching a creative hit a rough edge, and shipping the fix that same hour.

Adding evals and traces that tell us, honestly, whether the agent got better this week.

Polishing canvas interactions that thousands of creatives touch every day — the small details users never explicitly notice but always feel.

You’ll work directly with senior engineers and the founders. Expect fast feedback, real code review, and more ownership than you’ve been trusted with before.

You’ll fit if you

Are pursuing a degree in CS (or equivalent) and have built something real: a side project people actually used, open source contributions, a previous internship where you shipped.

Are comfortable in TypeScript, or good enough at programming that you’ll be effective in it within a week.

Have played with LLMs beyond the chat box. Tool-calling, agent frameworks, React Flow, Yjs/CRDTs, or anything you hacked together at 2am are all table stakes.

Care about small details users never explicitly notice.

Are comfortable with uncertainty. We might implode tomorrow or we might grow 100,000,000% WoW next week.

Default to shipping. Let’s get shit done.

What we offer

$8500 monthly salary

$2500 monthly stipend for housing

$70 per diem for meals

In-person in NYC with a lean team of people who love the game, obsessed with building the future of creativity.

If this is the kind of problem you’re interested in, apply!

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Data Scientist Intern, Summer 2027 – St. Louis, MO, US

Why join Mastercard’s internship program? 
Mastercard's internship program offers more than hands-on work. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities. 

About the team: 
Build and deliver sustainable Tooling. Process, and Practice discipline across the Network oganization that enables best-in-class Portfolio Management, Organizational Reporting, Budget Management, Business Governance, and Delivery Execution. 
Objectives 
1 - Design and build best-in-class processes and tooling for execution and tracking of Network Execution and Delivery (BAU and Change) - ensuring adherence / supporting relevant compliance and auditability measures 
2 - Aggregate and streamline 'observability' of the Network Programs "Book of Work' including Program Execution, Operational Metrics, and Capacity Planning - leveraging accurate, timely data to ensure awareness and informed decisioning by Senior Management. Leverage data across network teams to drive operational improvement and accountability 
3 - Coach, develop, and mentor team members in Program, Process, and Analytical disciplines with techniques that enable us to move faster, more effectively, and deliver better services and capabilities to the Network organization 
4 - Build effective partnerships across Networks Program, and stakeholders in ONE and the business - ensuring our team becomes trusted advisors and contributors across stakeholders, initiatives, and teams 
5 - Execute and Deliver 'special projects' as needed that drive operational excellence the Network Program. 
6 - Promote individual development, visibility, and skill growth through training, skill enhancement, and meaningful, visible projects across Network for each member of the team 

What we’re looking for: 
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelors degree in Data Science or a related field, with an anticipated graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028 
- Experience through coursework, internships, or academic projects in data modeling, data transformation, and data analysis. 
- Ability to organize and structure data into meaningful insights and compelling business narratives. 
- Hands-on experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI 
- Proficient Python, SQL is a strong plus. 
- Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform tools, including Dataverse and Power Automate. 
- Demonstrated leadership, project management, or team collaboration experience through academic, extracurricular, or internship activities. 
- This role is not eligible for Mastercard’s work authorization sponsorship. As such, candidates must be eligible to work in the United States, now as well as in the future, without employer sponsorship. For example, students or recent graduates in the United States on an F1 visa (including those with CPT or OPT authorization) are not eligible for this role.  

As an intern, you'll benefit from:

Description

 

 
Summer 2027 AI Full Stack Developer Consulting Intern

AI-Assisted Code | CI/CD & DevOps

Location: Minneapolis, Mn (Hybrid but based in Mn for summer)

Dates: June 1 - August 21, 2027 (10–12 weeks)

Status: Internship | Full-Time | Paid

Eligibility: Undergraduate, Master’s, Graduate-Level or PhD Students 

Extension:  Potential extension; remote work may be considered

Elire and Role Overview 

Elire is a trusted Oracle consulting partner with over 20 years of experience delivering ERP, EPM, HCM, and Treasury transformations across public and private sector clients using PeopleSoft, Oracle Cloud, and Treasury Management Systems such as Kyriba and FIS. We combine deep business and technical expertise with a people-first, consulting-driven approach to help organizations modernize systems, improve decision-making, and prepare for the future of work.

As AI continues to reshape how organizations operate, Elire is investing in responsible, human-in-the-loop AI solutions that enhance - not replace - our consultants and clients. Our Summer 2027 AI Full Stack Developer Consulting Internship program gives advanced graduate students hands-on exposure to applied AI in a real consulting environment, with an emphasis on practical problem-solving, sound technical judgment, and work that can move from concept toward usable solutions.

The Opportunity

The AI Full Stack Developer Consulting Intern will focus on building and reviewing software in an AI-enabled development environment. This role is designed for a strong programmer who can assess code written or assisted by AI, identify issues, improve quality, and work within modern software delivery practices including source control, CI/CD, GitOps, and DevOps. The right candidate will be comfortable both creating code and challenging whether generated code is secure, maintainable, testable, and fit for purpose.

Key Responsibilities: 

Develop, review, test, debug, and improve code used in Elire AI prototypes, tools, integrations, and internal solutions.

Review AI-generated or AI-assisted code for correctness, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with development standards.

Build or support scripts, services, APIs, automations, and proof-of-value applications using appropriate programming languages and frameworks.

Work with Git-based source control, branching, pull requests, code review, and version-management practices.

Support CI/CD workflows and help automate build, test, deployment, and validation processes.

Apply GitOps and DevOps concepts to improve repeatability, traceability, and reliability of software delivery.

Troubleshoot technical issues, evaluate alternative solutions, and explain the reasoning behind implementation decisions.

Document code, workflows, testing results, and technical recommendations; collaborate with Elire AI and technical leaders and present a final project.

Required Qualifications: 

Currently pursuing an Undergraduate, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, Cloud Computing, Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including IP addressing, subnets, routing, DNS, connectivity, and network security concepts.

Hands-on knowledge of virtual cloud networking / VCN concepts and cloud infrastructure.

Experience with Kubernetes (K8s), RKE2, or comparable container-orchestration technologies.

Understanding of cluster deployment, scaling, availability, and troubleshooting concepts.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills; able to diagnose technical issues and make reasoned infrastructure recommendations.

Ability to document architectures, configurations, issues, and technical decisions clearly and professionally.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on exposure to CI/CD platforms, GitOps workflows, DevOps tooling, or infrastructure-as-code practices.

Experience with containers, Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-native application development.

Exposure to generative AI APIs, coding copilots, LLM-based development workflows, or agentic development tools.

Exposure to cloud platforms such as Oracle Cloud, AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Prior research, internship, open-source, or project experience building production-oriented software or AI-enabled applications.

What You’ll Gain: 

Real-world experience applying AI and advanced technology in a consulting and enterprise environment.

Hands-on work with experienced consultants, technical leaders, and Elire innovation initiatives.

Professional development focused on critical thinking, communication, problem-solving, and client-ready delivery.

The opportunity to own meaningful work and present findings or a final project at the end of the internship.

Potential consideration for an internship extension based on business need and performance; an extension may be remote.

Who Will Be Successful

This internship is intended for someone who is technically capable, curious, self-directed, and comfortable being challenged. We are looking for a graduate student who can do the work, think critically about the work, ask strong questions, and use AI as a tool without outsourcing technical judgment to it.

About Elire: 

Elire is a Certified Partner of Oracle Cloud, PeopleSoft, Kyriba, and FIS. Established in 2005, Elire is a Minneapolis-based full-service consulting firm with 15+ years of experience in successfully completing projects for our customers all over the country. Over one hundred clients in the Public and Fortune 500 Financial, Services, and Utilities Sectors have benefited from Elire’s hands-on guidance and knowledge. 

We help achieve success by efficiently implementing, integrating, and upgrading software investments. We employ consultants with world-class skills and experience. To learn more, visit our website at www.elire.com 

Elire is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or veteran status.

Responsibilities

The Search team builds the systems that help users find relevant, reliable, and engaging content across TikTok. The team works across search retrieval, ranking, recommendation signals, query understanding, relevance, infrastructure, and product experiences. Our work combines large-scale machine learning, data-driven product development, and distributed systems to improve search quality for a global user base.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Responsibilities
- Support the design, implementation, testing, and iteration of Search features, services, or tools under the guidance of engineers and mentors.
- Work with large-scale data, logs, metrics, or experiments to understand user search behavior and improve product or system quality.
- Collaborate with engineering, product, data science, and machine learning partners to define requirements and deliver project milestones.
- Write clear, maintainable code and documentation for assigned workstreams.
- Communicate progress, risks, and learnings with mentors and stakeholders throughout the internship.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
- Experience with at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C++, Go, or JavaScript through coursework, projects, internships, or equivalent practical experience.
- Familiarity with data structures, algorithms, software engineering fundamentals, and basic system design concepts.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with search, recommendation, machine learning, information retrieval, natural language processing, ranking, ads, content understanding, or data mining projects.
- Familiarity with databases, distributed systems, data pipelines, experimentation, or large-scale backend services.
- Experience using data to investigate product, user, or system problems.
- Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate with cross-functional partners.
- Interest in improving search experiences for large-scale consumer products.

The Opportunity:

The Summer Games is an innovative internship program that attracts some of the nation’s best and brightest students. The goal is to develop a breakthrough idea or solution for one of our customer's most pressing, complex, and multidimensional problems while developing valuable technical skills. This competitive and collaborative program attracts thousands of applicants each year. Simulating a real-world startup accelerator environment, the interns are divided into teams, each working on a different challenge project. Throughout the Games, interns receive mentorship from senior leaders, solve problems using Booz Allen’s products and unique engagement models, and leverage the power of collaboration in a team environment.

The summer culminates with a final Challenge Cup competition and presentation to senior leadership. A past winner took the challenge of helping blind individuals navigate by using new technology and developing a business and market penetration plan. Teams have also helped to develop an app that gives military commanders an easy way to track real-time and open-source information about developing situations, including sudden attacks, fighting human trafficking, and even tracking the spread of a disease worldwide.

Join us. The world can't wait.

Experience with data exploration, data cleaning, data analysis, data visualization, or data mining 

Experience with statistical and general-purpose programming languages for data analysis 

Knowledge of structured and unstructured data sources 

Ability to obtain a Secret clearance

Scheduled to obtain a Bachelor’s degree in a Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics field by Summer 2028 or Summer 2029

Ability to produce technical documentation and create design artifacts

About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

Ready to run

Hungry and driven by urgency

Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

Comfortable operating in motion

The Role

As an AI Research Intern, your mandate is to research and prototype foundation models, both transformer-based and graph-based, applied to OnePay's customer, transaction, and merchant data. You'll work on real modeling problems and build a working prototype that demonstrates the approach. This role will impact OnePay's vision by providing a remarkable customer experience, driving positive business outcomes, and improving operational efficiency. You will work closely with the product, engineering and applied science team(s) working across all business units. This role reports to the Head of AI/ML.

This role is responsible for:

Research, design, and train foundation models on OnePay's data, working with transformer and/or graph-based architectures.

Run experiments, evaluate results rigorously, and turn promising findings into a working prototype.

Opportunity to work in an extremely fast paced growing company

Partner with Product, Engineering and Analytics teams to ensure we are providing a remarkable customer experience.

Driving significant impact on the company’s bottom line.

You Bring

Final-Year Graduate Student: You’re in the final year of a master’s or PhD program, expected to graduate in Fall 2027 or Spring 2028, majoring in Engineering or a related field.

Deep Learning Fundamentals: You have a strong grasp of how neural networks work under the hood, including backpropagation, attention, embeddings, optimization, and training dynamics. You've implemented, trained, or fine-tuned models yourself through research, coursework, or personal projects, and you're comfortable working in PyTorch or an equivalent framework.

Prior Experience: You've completed at least one previous internship in research, machine learning, or software engineering, or have built substantial personal or academic projects you're excited to talk through.

Availability: This is a full-time, 8-week program running June 21 - August 13, 2027. You are available to work in our New York City office at least 3-4 days a week throughout.

Proactive & Collaborative Attitude: You have an act-like-an-owner mentality, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and enjoy working with others to achieve collective goals.

Critical Thinking & Problem-Solving Skills: You enjoy tackling complex challenges, analyzing problems, and developing solutions. Clear communication of ideas is one of your strengths.

Organized & Detail-Oriented: You’re a keen listener with strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple tasks efficiently.

Excited to Learn & Grow: You are passionate about being part of a rapidly growing start-up and look forward to expanding your skills in a real-world setting.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with transformer-based foundation model architectures, including pre-training, fine-tuning, inference, and the tradeoffs between approaches.

Exposure to graph-based learning or graph foundation models, such as GNNs, message passing, or representation learning on graph-structured data.

Coursework or projects involving Large Language Models or Generative AI.

Research output in any of the above: publications, workshop papers, or open-source contributions.

What We Offer

Early access to a high potential, high growth fintech

Hands on experience building product ready to ship

Beautiful NYC SoHo Office

Professional development and team social outings

Program & Application Timeline

Program runs June 21 - August 13, 2027 (8 weeks, full-time, in our NYC office)

We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis as they come in

No offer decisions will be made until the application window closes – all candidates are evaluated together before final decisions go out

We are targeting a finalized cohort by December 1, 2026

If there are intern spots still available, we may reopen applications in Spring 2027

Work Authorization: OnePay will not sponsor applicants who need employment sponsored visas for this position. Future sponsorship will not be considered.

Standard Interview Process

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

AI-assisted initial screen

Interview with Talent Partner

Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

Team Interview

Executive Interview

Offer!

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. Company Overview:  

For more than 50 years, NISC has developed and implemented enterprise-level and customer-facing software solutions for over 1200+ utilities and broadbands across North America. Our mission is to deliver technology solutions and services that are Member-focused, quality driven and valued priced. We exist to serve our Members and help them serve their communities through our innovative software products, services and outstanding customer support. NISC has been ranked in ComputerWorld’s Best Places to Work for twenty-two years, and we are looking for qualified individuals to join our team.  

Our Members have over 18 million end customers (residential and businesses who receive power, internet, television and/or telephone services) that our enterprise software solution enables our Members to compete effectively in the industry, while excelling in customer service.   

Position Overview: 

This position reports to an AI Development Team Lead and will collaborate with software developers, business teams, and technical stakeholders across the organization. This position is responsible for assisting with the research, development, testing, and implementation of AI-driven solutions that support NISC's software development lifecycle and business operations. Interns will gain hands-on experience exploring emerging AI technologies, analyzing business processes, prototyping innovative solutions, and evaluating opportunities to improve efficiency through intelligent automation.

Based on intern interest and business needs, opportunities may exist to contribute to projects involving generative AI, machine learning, natural language processing, intelligent automation, software development, and data analysis. Adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for learning new technologies are essential.

To Learn more about NISC's internships, click HERE.

Assists with researching and evaluating emerging AI technologies, tools, and frameworks.

Assists in analyzing business processes and workflows to identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements.

Performs testing and validation of AI solutions and related software enhancements.

Assists with data analysis, preparation, and organization in support of AI and machine learning initiatives.

Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

San Francisco, CA

Apply

Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military. 

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Software Engineer - Enterprise Systems Intern (Summer 2027)

As a Software Engineer Intern, you'll build and extend the systems that ingest, store, and query the massive streams of telemetry flowing from our satellite fleet in real time. From designing data pipelines that handle thousands of channels per spacecraft to building monitoring rules that catch anomalies before they become problems, your work will give mission operators the visibility they need to keep satellites healthy and online.

You'll be working at the intersection of data engineering and space operations, building tools that turn raw satellite signals into actionable insight.                                                                                                     

This role will contribute to both our commercial and US government programs.

Role

Design and build monitoring rules and anomaly detection capabilities for our telemetry data platform

Contribute across the data platform by building out client libraries, data pipelines, query interfaces, and APIs                  

Collaborate with mission operations and engineering teams to define monitoring requirements and data needs

Requirements

Currently pursuing a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, or equivalent degree

Strong proficiency in Python

Experience and understanding of databases (Postgres, time-series databases, etc)

Experience and understanding of API design (REST, gRPC, Protocol Buffers)

Don't meet them all? Not a problem. Please apply even if you do not meet all these criteria.

Bonus

Experience with time-series data or telemetry systems

Experience with async Python programming

Experience with Kubernetes

The base pay for this position is $29.00 per hour.

Base Hourly Pay

$29 - $29 USD

U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

 

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

Draw in senior developers to help when needed.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Be a student who is enrolled full-time and pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree from an accredited college/university and will be enrolled full time in Fall 2027

Be majoring in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or other related STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) degree

Be available to work full-time (40 hours per week) for at least 10 weeks during summer 2027.

Be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite) as well as Program Special access within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)

Have an overall cumulative GPA of 3.00/4.0 or higher

Experience using benchtop instrumentation (e.g. spectrum analyzers and digital multimeters).

Ability to interpret basic circuit diagrams and engineering drawings 

Experience troubleshooting analog or high-voltage circuitry

Programming and/or automation experience (e. g. MATLAB, Labview, Python, C/C++, C#, and Visual Basic)

PLC programming experience (e.g. Allen Bradley)

Experience testing magnetic bearings or other rotating machinery 

Acoustics, dynamics, or control-systems testing experience

Experience using multi-channel data acquisition (DAQ) systems

Experience testing large structures

Systems Engineering experience

Navy or other military experience

Active U.S. DoD Secret security clearance
